fixes.explanation: Yes, Father, baker. The prayer says, “Yet You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us and Israel does not acknowledge us.” Then it says it again: “You, O LORD, are our Father…” Abraham does not know them, and Israel does not acknowledge them. Still, the prayer holds on to that name.
